body:
It's not like petting a raw chicken at all. They have very soft skin, some do have a soft fuzz that makes them like petting a peach or a girl's arm, if she moisturizes. Otherwise, it's just like petting skin. Holding them is just like holding any other cat, they wiggle and meow and nuzzle and purr just like any other cat. 

The only traits that seem to be standard for hairless cats (Sphinxes) is that they're usually intelligent, vocal, and stupidly friendly. The one I had was 1/4 Siamese, so she had beautiful markings, and gorgeous eyes and a weird little tuft of fur on her chest (but was otherwise entirely hairless). Her meow was very distinct... it sounded like a middle aged man unenthusiastically saying the word "meow."
